items.quote: By far the best experience I've ever had with an auto shop. Long story short, I am military and was driving cross country with my 3 kids and two dogs when my radiator blew. They took me in like family and got the work done in a hour and had me back on the road with an amazing price.
items.name: Dimitris Sotos

items.quote: The absolute best service! They will not try to sell you something you don't need, but are very honest about what you do need to have repaired. In fact, it is a family business through and through, and at least one of the granddaughters is a grease monkey right and proper. She actually did my tune-up!
items.name: Linda Waters

items.quote: After being stranded in Biggs Junction for the weekend with a failed fuel pump and getting no help from the local shop there, I called C.A.R.S. & spoke with Shelby, he told us he could get us in as soon as we got there. He had us back on the road in just a few hours at a very reasonable cost.
items.name: Steve Mack

items.quote: Wow, amazing old-school service! Midway on a road trip with my baby and wife, I noticed the AC in my Honda wasn't performing well. These folks got me in same-day and recharged my AC for a very good price.
items.name: Google review

items.quote: Very helpful, kind and honest repair shop. They are willing to give advice and upfront about what things cost and competitive prices. Will visit again, thank you

items.quote: I was passing through Biggs Junction, and had a problem with the trailer hitch on my pick up truck. Called around, and Randy's crew stepped up and managed to slip us in to replace the hitch. Very reasonable price, prompt service, and oh-so happy customer.

about.title: Family owned since 1997
paragraphs: In 1997, we began as an automotive sales and repair facility. Ten years later, C.A.R.S. added classic car restoration and light and heavy-duty trailer sales. Today we focus on automotive restorations, automotive and trailer repairs, and appraisals.

A family owned and operated business, our staff value our customers' loyalty and commitment to shopping locally and supporting small businesses. We are passionate about our industry and do our best to bring our knowledge to you.
We do our best to treat our clients like we would treat our friends and family. Please feel free to stop by with your auto repair, restoration, or trailer repair questions.

estimate.title: What's going on with your car?
estimate.text: Tell us about your car, truck or trailer and we'll get back to you. Or call (541) 296-2094, Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm. For a restoration, please call or stop by before bringing the vehicle down so we can be sure we have an opening.
estimate.thanks: Thanks! Our team will get back to you soon to set up a time.

services.name: Classic Auto Restoration
services.intro: Classic auto restoration and repair is our game. We work on a wide variety of vintage classic cars and trucks, and specialize in 30s to 80s Chevrolet, Ford, Dodge/Chrysler, Oldsmobile, Plymouth, AMC, Jeep and others. Restorations can be a lengthy process, so we'll talk through expected timelines and our restoration policies before we start.
includes: Chevrolet, Ford, Dodge, AMC, Jeep and more
